sources.method: Residential straight-line method, mid-month service convention, building-only basis and reasonable shared cost allocation
Independent California depreciation basis and adjustment books

worksheetSteps: Building-only recovery basis supplied explicitly; purchase/market value and land do not create basis
January availability recovers 11.5 months; July tenancy supplies six months rent of 100000 cents
Depreciation = original book basis / 330 months * 11.5 months; nearest cent direct-method worksheet
Shared ADU ratio = 500/(1500+500); annual property tax 100001 settles to 25000 rental, 75001 personal
Shared insurance 10000 -> 2500 rental, 7500 personal; twelve direct repairs total120000
Cash flow excludes depreciation; taxable profit subtracts operating expenses and each separate depreciation book
Whole rental fixture allocates all shared costs to rental and never puts them in personal itemization
Unused tax/payroll/retirement rule fields are inert synthetic inputs; these cases claim only property-method references
